SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = 'G0483')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, submission_date AS first_submission
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) = 1
)
SELECT p.payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims,
       round(median(date_diff('day', p.first_submission, r.payment_date)), 1) AS median_days,
       round(quantile_cont(date_diff('day', p.first_submission, r.payment_date), 0.9), 1) AS p90_days
FROM prim p
JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key
 AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT carc_code FROM (
  SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT r.claim_payer_key) AS n
  FROM sem.adjustments a
  JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
  WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, a.carc_code LIMIT 5)

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, count(*) AS events,
         bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS current_clean
  FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND current_clean) AS first_pass,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND current_clean) / count(*), 2) AS rate_pct
FROM ev GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT payer_class, claim_key, payer_key,
         count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS traces,
         bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal,
         bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current,
         sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) AS current_paid
  FROM sem.remit_claims
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  HAVING count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) >= 2
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS with_reversal,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS no_current,
       round(coalesce(sum(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM pairs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

SELECT round(coalesce(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 0), 2)
FROM sem.adjustments a
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sem.claims c
    WHERE c.claim_key = a.claim_key AND c.payer_key = a.payer_key AND c.payer_responsibility = 'P')

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT claim_key, referring_npi, service_month FROM sem.claims
  WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'
), tot AS (
  SELECT service_month, count(*) AS total_claims FROM latest GROUP BY 1
), ranked AS (
  SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS n,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY count(*) DESC, referring_npi) AS rn
  FROM latest WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
), top AS (
  SELECT service_month, sum(n) AS top5 FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT strftime(t.service_month, '%Y-%m') AS month, t.total_claims, coalesce(p.top5, 0),
       round(100.0 * coalesce(p.top5, 0) / t.total_claims, 1)
FROM tot t LEFT JOIN top p USING (service_month) ORDER BY t.service_month

SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = '87798')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines
  WHERE is_latest_submission AND procedure_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT l.procedure_code, avg(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS denial_rate
FROM lines l
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = l.claim_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 20

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission
), prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) = 1
), adj AS (
  SELECT p.claim_key, r.is_denied FROM prim p
  JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT CASE WHEN l.line_count = 1 THEN '1' WHEN l.line_count = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS bucket,
       count(*) AS claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied) AS denied,
       round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN a.is_denied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(coalesce(sum(l.charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied), 0), 2) AS denied_billed
FROM latest l JOIN adj a ON a.claim_key = l.claim_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH neg AS (
  SELECT provider_adjustment_id, payer_key, reference_id, payment_date AS carry_date, provider_adjustment_amount
  FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB' AND provider_adjustment_amount < 0
), pos AS (
  SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount
  FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB' AND provider_adjustment_amount > 0
), paired AS (
  SELECT n.reference_id, n.carry_date, round(-n.provider_adjustment_amount, 2) AS amount,
         p.payment_date AS offset_date,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY n.provider_adjustment_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS rn
  FROM neg n
  LEFT JOIN pos p ON p.payer_key = n.payer_key AND p.reference_id = n.reference_id
   AND p.provider_adjustment_amount = -n.provider_adjustment_amount AND p.payment_date > n.carry_date
)
SELECT reference_id, carry_date, amount, offset_date, date_diff('day', carry_date, offset_date) AS days
FROM paired WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY carry_date, reference_id

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT payer_class, date_trunc('month', payment_date)::DATE AS payment_month, paid_amount
  FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication
), agg AS (
  SELECT payer_class, payment_month, sum(paid_amount) AS paid FROM cur
  WHERE payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01') GROUP BY 1, 2
), tot AS (SELECT payment_month, sum(paid) AS month_paid FROM agg GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.payer_class,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN a.paid ELSE 0 END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN t.month_paid END), 0), 1),
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01' THEN a.paid ELSE 0 END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01' THEN t.month_paid END), 0), 1),
       round(100.0 * (
         sum(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01' THEN a.paid ELSE 0 END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01' THEN t.month_paid END), 0)
       - sum(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN a.paid ELSE 0 END) / nullif(max(CASE WHEN a.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN t.month_paid END), 0)
       ), 1)
FROM agg a JOIN tot t ON t.payment_month = a.payment_month
GROUP BY a.payer_class

WITH prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) = 1
), orig AS (
  SELECT c.claim_key, min(c.submission_date) AS original_date
  FROM sem.claims c JOIN prim p ON p.claim_key = c.claim_key AND p.payer_key = c.payer_key
  WHERE c.frequency_code = '1' GROUP BY 1
), repl AS (
  SELECT c.claim_key, min(c.submission_date) AS replacement_date
  FROM sem.claims c JOIN prim p ON p.claim_key = c.claim_key AND p.payer_key = c.payer_key
  WHERE c.frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1
), cur AS (
  SELECT r.claim_key, r.payment_date, r.paid_amount
  FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN prim p ON p.claim_key = r.claim_key AND p.payer_key = r.payer_key
  WHERE r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT count(*),
       round(avg(date_diff('day', o.original_date, rp.replacement_date)), 2),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= rp.replacement_date),
       round(avg(date_diff('day', o.original_date, c.payment_date)) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= rp.replacement_date), 2),
       round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= rp.replacement_date), 0), 2)
FROM repl rp JOIN orig o ON o.claim_key = rp.claim_key
LEFT JOIN cur c ON c.claim_key = rp.claim_key

WITH voids AS (
  SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS void_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM voids),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM voids v WHERE EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
          WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date)),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM voids v WHERE EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
          WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date)),
       (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(r.paid_amount), 0), 2) FROM sem.remit_claims r
          JOIN voids v ON v.claim_key = r.claim_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication)

SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount = 0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH repl AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, arg_min(payer_class, submission_date) AS payer_class,
         min(submission_date) AS correction_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2
), resp AS (
  SELECT r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key,
         date_diff('day', r.correction_date, min(m.payment_date)) AS days
  FROM repl r
  JOIN sem.remit_claims m ON m.claim_key = r.claim_key AND m.payer_key = r.payer_key
   AND m.payment_date >= r.correction_date
  GROUP BY r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.correction_date
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*), round(avg(days), 1), min(days), max(days)
FROM resp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) FROM (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication))

SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = '80307')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, submission_date AS first_submission
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) = 1
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM prim
  WHERE first_submission >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND first_submission < DATE '2026-08-01'
), first_remit AS (
  SELECT c.claim_key, min(r.payment_date) AS first_pay
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = c.claim_key AND r.payer_key = c.payer_key
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.payer_class, count(*) AS cohort_claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_diff('day', c.first_submission, f.first_pay) <= 14) AS within_14,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_diff('day', c.first_submission, f.first_pay) <= 14) / count(*), 1) AS share_pct
FROM cohort c JOIN first_remit f ON f.claim_key = c.claim_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = 'G0482')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH repl AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS correction_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2
), elig AS (
  SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.correction_date FROM repl r
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims m
    WHERE m.claim_key = r.claim_key AND m.payer_key = r.payer_key
      AND m.is_denied_recorded AND m.payment_date < r.correction_date)
), flags AS (
  SELECT e.claim_key, e.payer_key,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims m
                 WHERE m.claim_key = e.claim_key AND m.payer_key = e.payer_key
                   AND m.payment_date >= e.correction_date) AS remit_since,
         (SELECT m.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims m
          WHERE m.claim_key = e.claim_key AND m.payer_key = e.payer_key AND m.is_current_adjudication) AS current_denied,
         (SELECT m.paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims m
          WHERE m.claim_key = e.claim_key AND m.payer_key = e.payer_key AND m.is_current_adjudication) AS current_paid
  FROM elig e
)
SELECT outcome, count(*), round(coalesce(sum(paid), 0), 2) FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT remit_since THEN 'no remit since correction'
              WHEN current_denied IS NOT NULL AND NOT current_denied THEN 'overturned'
              ELSE 'denied again' END AS outcome,
         coalesce(current_paid, 0) AS paid
  FROM flags
) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied
), earlier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE NOT is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied
)
SELECT count(*), round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount), 0), 2)
FROM cur c JOIN earlier e ON e.claim_key = c.claim_key AND e.payer_key = c.payer_key

WITH prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, submission_date AS first_submission
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) = 1
), latest AS (
  SELECT claim_key, charge_amount, frequency_code FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission
), open_ar AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN date_diff('day', p.first_submission, DATE '2026-08-14') <= 14 THEN '0-14'
           WHEN date_diff('day', p.first_submission, DATE '2026-08-14') <= 29 THEN '15-29'
           ELSE '30+' END AS bucket,
         l.charge_amount
  FROM latest l
  JOIN prim p ON p.claim_key = l.claim_key
  WHERE l.frequency_code IS DISTINCT FROM '8'
    AND date_diff('day', p.first_submission, DATE '2026-08-14') >= 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
      WHERE r.claim_key = l.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)
)
SELECT bucket, count(*), round(coalesce(sum(charge_amount), 0), 2)
FROM open_ar GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0-14' THEN 1 WHEN '15-29' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT count(*) FROM (
  SELECT claim_key FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1
  HAVING min(submission_date) >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND min(submission_date) < DATE '2026-08-01'
) f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = f.claim_key)

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount
  FROM sem.remit_lines
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND units_paid = 1 AND line_allowed_amount > 0
), freq AS (
  SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount AS typical, count(*) AS n
  FROM lines GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), typical AS (
  SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, typical FROM freq
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_name, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, typical DESC) = 1
)
SELECT l.payer_name,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.line_allowed_amount < t.typical) AS underpaid,
       round(coalesce(sum(t.typical - l.line_allowed_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.line_allowed_amount < t.typical), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM lines l JOIN typical t USING (payer_name, procedure_code)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shortfall DESC, l.payer_name

SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = 'G0480')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH m AS (
  SELECT payer_class, payment_month,
         count(*) AS current_adjudications,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied,
         avg(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate
  FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       current_adjudications, denied,
       round(100.0 * rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(100.0 * (rate - lag(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month)), 2) AS mom_pp
FROM m ORDER BY 1, payment_month

SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE upper(procedure_code) = '81479')
       / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0)
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH prim AS (
  SELECT claim_key, referring_npi, payer_key
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND referring_npi IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) = 1
)
SELECT referring_npi, avg(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS denial_rate
FROM prim p
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 15
ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, referring_npi LIMIT 5
